spans.s:
r. 4th cl. (ञि, औ) ञिऔतुष (तुष्यति)
To be satisfied or content, to be pleased or delighted.

mf. (-षः-षा)
1 The husk or chaff of rice, &c.
2 Beleric myrobalan.
E.
तुष to please or be pleased, affix क.

r. 1st cl. (तोसति)
To sound.

m. (-सः)
The husk of corn or rice: see तुष.

r. 1st cl. (तूषति)
1 To satisfy.
2 To be satisfied or happy.

m. (-हः)
Agni or fire.
E.
तुष chaff, and ग्रह who seizes.

m. (-रः)
Agni or fire.
E.
तुष chaff, and सार who embraces, from सृ to go, with अण् aff.

m. (-लः)
1 A conflagration of chaff, or of the husk of corn.
2 A capital punishment, burning; twisting dry straw, &c. round the limbs of a criminal, and setting it on fire.
E.
तुष, and अनल fire.

mfn. (-रः-रा-रं)
Cold, frigid, frosty.
m. (-रः)
1

Frost.
2

Cold.
3

Thin rain, mist.
4 Ice or snow.
5 The name of a country.
E.
तुष to please, Uṇādi affix आरन्.

m. (-णः)
1 A dew drop.
2 An icicle.
3 Hoar frost.
E.
तुषार, and कण a particle.

m. (-लः)
Winter, the cold^1 season.
E.
तुषार, and काल time.
[1] Correction submitted by Dr. Sampada Savardekar on 20210731. Reference: https://github.com/sanskrit-lexicon/csl-corrections/issues/66.

m. (-तः)
1 Thin rain, a sprinkling, a shower.
2 A fall of snow.
E.
तुषार, and पात falling.

m. (-द्रिः)
The Himālaya mountain.
E.
तुषार, and अद्रि a mountain; also similar compounds, as तुषारपर्व्वत, तुषारशैल, &c.

m. (-तः)
A Tuṣita, a kind of subordinate deity, one of a class of thirty-six.
E.
तुष to please, इतच् aff.

n. (-कं)
Rice gruel.
E.
तुष to satisfy, and उदक water.

mfn. (-ष्टः-ष्टा-ष्टं)
Pleased, satisfied.
E.
तुष to be pleased, affix क्त.

f. (-ष्टिः)
1 Pleasure, satisfaction, gratification, content.
2 Indifference to every thing but that possessed or obtained.
3 One of the Mātṛs.
E.
तुष to please, &c. affix क्तिन्.

mfn. (-रः-रा-रं)
Pleasing, satisfying.
E.
तुष्टि, and कर what makes.

mfn. (-नः-नी-नं)
Gratifying, giving or producing satisfaction.
E.
तुष्टि, and जनन birth.

mfn. (-दः-दा-दं)
Pleasing, satisfying.
E.
तुष्टि, and द what gives.

m. (-ष्टुः)
A jewel worn in the ears.
E.
तुष to please, क्तु aff.

ind.
Having pleased or gratified.
E.
तुष, and क्त्वा aff.

n. (-स्तं)
Dust.
E.
तुस to sound, affix क्त: see तूस्त.

Dust.
2

Clotted hair.
3

Sin.
4

An atom, a very thin or delicate substance.
E.
तूस to sound, Uṇādi affix तन्, and the radical vowel made long.

mfn. (-लः-ला-लं)
Silent, taciturn.
E.
तूष्णीम् silent, and शील practising.

mfn. (-कः-का-कं)
Silent, taciturn.
E.
तूष्णीम् silent, अकच् affix, and म dropped.

ind.
Silent, silently.
E.
तूष्णीम् silent, and काम् aff.

ind.
Silent, silently.
E.
तुष to please or be pleased, affix नीम्, and उ made long.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Silent.
E.
तूष्णीम्, and भूत become.
